msItem.incipit: -1rعَزيْزاً حَكِيْماً وَاِنْ مِن اَهْلِ الكِتَابِ اِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنِّ بِهِ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِSūrat al-nisā', verses 158-159. The actual beginning of the ǧuz' is on fol. 18v.
msItem.explicit: -18vوَالَّذِيْنَ اَمَنُوْا بِاللَهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقُوْا بَيْنَ أَحَدٍSūrat al-nisā', verse 152. The actual end of the ǧuz' is on fol. 9v.
msItem.note: 4:148-5:82. Disorganized, beginning of the ǧuz’ on f. 18v and at the end of the ǧuz’ is on f. 9v. Titles of suras rubricated. Ends of verses marked by 3 red dots. First words of the ǧuz’ enhanced in red ink, as are some letters, in particular the double lām of Allāh. Above some final hā’-s placed at the end of a line, appear a little hā’, especially for Allāh, but not only (ihmāl ?). On almost all folios, words completed on the following line. Many words left uncompleted without diacritic and vocalization at the end of a line, rewritten in full on the following line. Several wāw-s at ends of lines rewritten on the following line. Extension of letters (often mīm), sometimes of words, into the margin. Deletions. Some corrections in the margins, and mark of ḥizb in red (fol. 11r).

item.q: اللهم صل علي محمد وعلى ال محمد
item.note: Written by a different hand below the end of the ǧuz'.
